description: In repos/llm-resolver-vessel/src/index.ts, in the OPENAI_WIRE_PROVIDERS startup loop, the keyless-provider branch (the one that logs "SKIPPED at startup" and calls reportMissingKey when the provider api key env is empty and no defaultKey exists) must `continue` to the next provider instead of falling through to `new OpenAI({apiKey: key, ...})`. The current comment says "DO NOT continue; instead, initialize client with dummy key so it appears in quota state" but the code passes the EMPTY string, and the OpenAI SDK constructor throws "Missing credentials" on an empty apiKey — so one keyless provider kills the entire vessel at boot in a systemd restart loop (measured 2026-09-16 06:06-06:07 on the live substrate after removing a placeholder GOOGLE_API_KEY; the vessel crash-looped until the branch was hot-patched to continue). Replace the comment and the fall-through with a `continue;` so a keyless provider forfeits its models cleanly, exactly as the branch's own warning text already claims ("forfeiting N model(s)").
